description.default: Drive this machine's ffmpeg/ffprobe from the agent: environment and capability checks, probing, black-frame/silence/scene analysis, transcoding with two-pass and rate control, trimming, frame grabs, GIF/WebP export, waveforms and spectrograms, effects and grading, crop and text, subtitle burn-in and muxing, metadata and chapters, concat and Ken Burns slideshows, overlay and audio mixing, HLS/DASH packaging and RTMP/SRT pushing, screen and device capture, plus a raw argv escape hatch. Local only, never uploads, and reports install guidance when ffmpeg is missing.
description.zh-CN: 在本机用 ffmpeg/ffprobe 处理你指定的图片、音频与视频：环境自检与能力查询、信息探测、黑帧/静音/场景等分析、转码压缩（含两遍编码与码率控制）、剪辑、抽帧、GIF/WebP 动图、波形与频谱图、特效调色、裁剪打字、字幕烧录与封装、元数据与章节、拼接与运镜幻灯片、图层与混音、HLS/DASH 打包与推流、录屏与设备采集，以及任意参数的兜底直通。默认不联网、不上传，未安装 ffmpeg 时给出安装引导。
description.zh-TW: 在本機用 ffmpeg/ffprobe 處理你指定的圖片、音訊與影片：環境自檢與能力查詢、資訊探測、黑幀／靜音／場景等分析、轉碼壓縮（含兩遍編碼與位元率控制）、剪輯、抽幀、GIF/WebP 動圖、波形與頻譜圖、特效調色、裁剪打字、字幕燒錄與封裝、中繼資料與章節、拼接與運鏡幻燈片、圖層與混音、HLS/DASH 打包與串流、螢幕與裝置擷取，以及任意參數的兜底直通。預設不連網、不上傳，未安裝 ffmpeg 時提供安裝引導。
description.en: Drive this machine's ffmpeg/ffprobe from the agent: environment and capability checks, probing, black-frame/silence/scene analysis, transcoding with two-pass and rate control, trimming, frame grabs, GIF/WebP export, waveforms and spectrograms, effects and grading, crop and text, subtitle burn-in and muxing, metadata and chapters, concat and Ken Burns slideshows, overlay and audio mixing, HLS/DASH packaging and RTMP/SRT pushing, screen and device capture, plus a raw argv escape hatch. Local only, never uploads, and reports install guidance when ffmpeg is missing.

privacy.note: 插件服务器在本机以子进程运行 ffmpeg/ffprobe，只读写本次调用给出的路径，产物写到调用方指定的输出路径；不读取会话正文、不读取密钥、不上传媒体。默认不联网：只有当调用方显式给出网络地址并同时允许网络（如 media_stream 的推流/录制、media_run 的 allowNetwork）时，才会连接该目标。录屏、录音与摄像头类操作会真实采集本机设备，需要系统权限；不安装、不修改系统设置。工具结果只包含命令摘要、媒体信息与产物路径，不含文件内容。未安装 ffmpeg 时只返回安装引导。
